setupTasks: Astro: set `site` in `astro.config.mjs` to your domain (the sitemap and canonical URLs use it).
instructions:
## How to work here

- It's a landing page: each section is a small, clear block (hero, features, FAQ, call to action). One main message and one main button.
- The sample copy is a placeholder: replace it with the product's before designing.
- SEO: every page has its own title, description and Open Graph; images have `alt` text and dimensions.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
